rows.commentary: 6.2: Will Jacks slides one straight through the defense of Babar Azam, catching the outside edge as the batter expects the turn.
6.3: Tossed up into the surface by Will Jacks, Babar Azam stays watchful to dead-bat the delivery into the off-side.
6.4: Will Jacks drops it a fraction shorter, allowing Babar Azam to carve it toward point where a fumble gifts the single.
6.5: Flighted up on middle and leg by Will Jacks, Saad Baig gets forward to nudge it down toward mid-off.
6.6: Will Jacks fires it full and drifting in, prompting Saad Baig to block it straight back to the bowler.
7.1: Gus Atkinson spears a full delivery into the pads, clipping the bat straight to Root stationed at short mid-wicket.
7.2: Gus Atkinson extracts sharp extra bounce and inward movement, forcing Babar Azam to let go of the bottom hand and drop it with soft wrists.
7.3: Gus Atkinson pins it right on a length close to off-stump, inviting Babar Azam onto the back foot to absorb the delivery.
7.4: Gus Atkinson strays onto the pads again, inducing an inside edge off Babar Azam's pads that dribbles away to backward square leg.
7.5: Coming from round the wicket, Gus Atkinson angles it in for Saad Baig to prod defensively toward the covers.
7.6: Gus Atkinson bangs it back of a length with a slight inward angle, pushed away smoothly into the off-side by Saad Baig.
8.1: Will Jacks grips this delivery into Babar Azam, who plays inside the sharp turn and is beaten completely.
8.2: Will Jacks loops it up on off and Babar Azam steps forward to block it dead.
8.3: Will Jacks darts it in from round the wicket and Babar Azam punches it toward mid-off for a sharp single.
8.4: Will Jacks fires one in past the off-stump and Saad Baig rocks back to punch it straight to point.
8.5: Will Jacks drops his pace with some turn, drawing an inside edge off Saad Baig's bat toward the leg-side.
8.6: Will Jacks keeps it flat and Saad Baig miscues his cut stroke straight to the cover fielder.
9.1: Gus Atkinson targets a back of a length outside off and Babar Azam dabs it down to third man for a single.
9.2: Gus Atkinson drifts it wide and Saad Baig steers it expertly to the fence at third man for four.
9.3: Gus Atkinson strays down leg, collecting a couple of leg byes as the ball scurries away to fine leg.
19.5: Jamie Overton bangs it short, and Saad Baig firmly jabs it straight into the turf at point.
19.6: Jamie Overton slides one across a length outside off, allowing Saad Baig to drop back and carve it toward deep cover for a single.
20.1: Adil Rashid drops it into the stumps with sharp turn, inducing a soft defensive push right back to his hands.
20.2: Adil Rashid tosses it up invitingly, and Saad Baig waits on the back foot to whip it away toward long-on for a brisk single.
20.3: Adil Rashid drifts one down the leg-side onto the pads, drawing a hopeful appeal as Hasan Nawaz misses his intended glance.
20.4: Adil Rashid floats up a tempting delivery, gently handled by Hasan Nawaz as he pushes it toward the cover region.
20.5: Adil Rashid finds the cue-end of the bat as Hasan Nawaz drags a hurried drive out to long-on to claim a single.
20.6: Adil Rashid deceives the batter with a sharp googly outside off, safely stabbed toward the fielder at cover.
21.1: Sonny Baker hits a length on target, and Hasan Nawaz angles his bat down to punch it toward point.
21.2: Sonny Baker pitches fuller outside off, checked softly to mid-off by Hasan Nawaz.
21.3: Sonny Baker fires it in very full and angled at the stumps, squeezed out toward cover by Hasan Nawaz.
21.4: Sonny Baker delivers a length ball that Hasan Nawaz aggressively charges and lofts over the leaping cover fielder for a boundary.
21.5: Sonny Baker darts it in onto the pads, and Hasan Nawaz simply nudges it across to the mid-wicket fielder.
21.6: Sonny Baker digs this one in short, and Hasan Nawaz wisely drops his head to let it pass overhead.
22.1: Adil Rashid drops it short outside off, allowing Saad Baig to chop it away to deep cover for a couple.
22.2: Adil Rashid tosses one down leg, catching Saad Baig on the pad as he attempts the paddle for a leg bye.
22.3: Adil Rashid gives this delivery plenty of loop, inviting Hasan Nawaz to push it firmly down to cover.
22.4: Adil Rashid serves up a very full delivery outside off, which Hasan Nawaz drills down to long-off for a single.
22.5: Dot ball from Adil Rashid to Saad Baig.
33.4: Jamie Overton tests the pitch with a short of length delivery outside off, steered firmly to backward point where Hasan Nawaz abandons a risky single.
33.5: Jamie Overton charges in round the wicket at pace, skidding a shortish ball into Arafat Minhas who hops gracefully to tuck it away.
33.6: Jamie Overton shifts over the wicket, sliding a back of a length ball down leg that Hasan Nawaz neatly deflects to fine leg to keep the strike.
34.1: Sam Curran introduces himself with a deceptive slower ball angling onto the pads, allowing Hasan Nawaz to flick it through square leg for a comfortable double.
34.2: Sam Curran serves a back of a length delivery punched through extra cover, sparking panic as Arafat Minhas ball-watches before scrambling back for a second run.
34.3: Sam Curran probes outside off with a sharp short of length ball, catching Hasan Nawaz flashing a cut straight to the fielder at point.
34.4: Sam Curran floats a glacial, full moon ball on middle, inviting Hasan Nawaz forward to stroke it firmly toward the covers.
34.5: Sam Curran delivers a back of a length ball shaping away on middle and leg, squaring up Hasan Nawaz who manages to dead-bat it toward the covers.
34.6: Sam Curran unfurls another looping slower ball into the blockhole, which Hasan Nawaz drills down to long-on to retain the strike.
35.1: Will Jacks darts a quick, flat delivery into off stump, neatly met by a punch from Hasan Nawaz straight down to long-on.
35.2: Will Jacks drops it a fraction short just outside off, allowing Arafat Minhas to punch it cleanly through the wide mid-on region.
35.3: Will Jacks drops it short outside off, and Hasan Nawaz arches back to slice a fierce cut past the cover fielder for four, bringing up the fifty-run partnership.
35.4: Will Jacks drops a full delivery into the middle, and Hasan Nawaz clips it smoothly through mid-wicket for a single.
35.5: Jacks drifts one back on a length outside off, allowing Minhas to drop his weight onto the back foot and punch a clean cut toward the sweeper in the deep.
35.6: Will Jacks serves it up on a turning line, which Hasan Nawaz reads well to work around the corner and keep the strike.
36.1: Sam Curran hammers a hard length onto middle and off, prompting Hasan Nawaz to rise on his toes and tuck it toward mid-wicket.
36.2: Sam Curran digs it in short toward the hips, and Hasan Nawaz moves inside the line to work it away.
36.3: No run for Arafat Minhas off Sam Curran.

46.5: Sam Curran drops one in to Arafat Minhas who launches it high toward long-on, where Banton leaps backward and acrobatically flicks the ball back inside the ropes while tumbling, conceding a pair of runs.
46.6: Sam Curran fires a full delivery into middle and off, which Arafat Minhas cleanly strokes down to long-on to comfortably retain the strike.
47.1: Sonny Baker steams in as Arafat Minhas shuffles leg-side to force a harsh cover drive off the toe-end straight back to the bowler.
47.2: Sonny Baker misses his yorker with a low full-toss outside off, allowing Arafat Minhas to drill it through the covers for a boundary that brings up his maiden ODI fifty.
47.3: Sonny Baker serves up a fuller length on middle and off, and Arafat Minhas stays leg-side to dispatch it over wide mid-off for consecutive boundaries.
47.4: Sonny Baker delivers a slower ball back of a length on off, which Arafat Minhas waits on before hammering it over extra cover for his third consecutive four.
47.5: Sonny Baker answers back with a searing wide yorker that evades Arafat Minhas entirely as the batter shuffles across his stumps attempting an audacious leg-side scoop.

47.6: Sonny Baker induces a top edge from Arafat Minhas as the batter clears room to swing across the line, sending a simple catch to Harry Brook who safely reverse-cups it at mid-off to end a fine fifty-nine.
48.1: Sam Curran slides in a slower low full-toss on off, permitting Faheem Ashraf to drill it out toward wide long-off for a single.
48.2: Sam Curran pitches a slower length delivery on off, allowing Shaheen Afridi to dead-bat it with soft hands toward wide mid-on to collect a quick run.
48.3: Sam Curran digs a slower short ball into the surface on off, deceiving Faheem Ashraf who mistimes his pull straight into the waiting hands of Will Jacks stationed at deep mid-wicket.
48.4: Sam Curran tosses up a sluggish length delivery outside off, which Naseem Shah punches out cleanly to wide long-on.
48.5: Sam Curran offers a tempting delivery right in the slot on off stump, only for Shaheen Afridi to clear his front leg with violent intent and smash it screaming through mid-on to the boundary.
48.6: Sam Curran strays with a half-volley outside off, and Afridi accepts the invitation with open arms, lashing consecutive boundaries through the covers to thrust Pakistan into the final over.
2.1: Shaheen Afridi drops the length ball outside off, forcing Ben Duckett to stab it firmly into the off-side.
2.2: Operating at 134.2 kph, Shaheen Afridi extracts late movement away from Ben Duckett, who pushes it straight back to the bowler.
2.3: Shaheen Afridi slips a lower full-toss down the leg-side, allowing Ben Duckett to clip it easily to deep fine leg for a single.
2.4: Tom Banton flashes his bat at a very full delivery from Shaheen Afridi that nips away outside off, missing the ball entirely.
2.5: Shaheen Afridi probes that fuller corridor outside off, and Tom Banton brings the bat down sharply to stab it firmly into the off-side.
2.6: Shaheen Afridi angles a length delivery across outside off, and Tom Banton watches it sail safely through to the keeper.
3.1: Naseem Shah curls a length delivery into Ben Duckett, who gets behind the line to defend it into the off-side.
3.2: Ben Duckett slashes wildly at a short, wide ball from Naseem Shah, getting an inside edge that races past the keeper to the boundary.
3.3: Naseem Shah angles it in sharply from a length, catching Ben Duckett on the inside edge and pads as he looks to tuck it away.
3.4: Naseem Shah offers a delivery angling across, prompting Ben Duckett to stab it deliberately toward cover.
3.5: Naseem Shah bangs it onto the leg stump, and Ben Duckett clips it wide of mid-on to collect a comfortable single.
3.6: Naseem Shah targets the off-stump with a length ball that shapes away, safely tapped back by Tom Banton toward mid-off.
4.1: Shaheen Afridi delivers a length ball angling into the pads, allowing Ben Duckett to tuck it toward long leg for a single.
4.2: Shaheen Afridi attacks on a length and angles one across Tom Banton, who watches it sail safely through to the keeper.
4.3: Shaheen Afridi targets the back of a length outside off, prompting Tom Banton to hang back and pat the ball down toward cover.
4.4: Shaheen Afridi slides a fuller delivery across the right-hander, inducing a frustrated drive and a miss from Tom Banton.
4.5: Shaheen Afridi digs in a sharp, 135-kph delivery at the body, forcing Tom Banton into a hurried swivel-pull toward the leg side for a scampered double.
4.6: Shaheen Afridi strays fuller and down leg, letting Tom Banton effortlessly clip it away to the fine leg boundary for four.
5.1: Naseem Shah fires a short delivery outside off, catching an under-edge off Ben Duckett's bat as he attempts a cut.
5.2: Naseem Shah offers width on a length, inviting Ben Duckett to slap it firmly on the up wide of cover for four.
14.4: Haris Rauf steams in and Joe Root pulls it down to deep square leg to rotate the strike with a single.
14.5: Haris Rauf delivers a back of a length ball outside off which Tom Banton solidly punches down to mid-off.
14.6: Tom Banton gets behind a fuller, angled delivery from Haris Rauf and drives it past mid-on for a boundary.
15.1: Saim Ayub tosses it up outside off and Joe Root pats it wide of short third man to comfortably collect a brace.
15.2: Saim Ayub loops it up and Joe Root strokes the ball down towards long-off for a brisk single.
15.3: Saim Ayub drops one short outside off, allowing Tom Banton to chop the ball down firmly towards cover.
15.4: Saim Ayub fires it in and Tom Banton quickly stabs the ball down into the off-side.
15.5: Tom Banton reaches his milestone fifty by patting a short delivery wide of point and sprinting back for two runs.
15.6: Saim Ayub drifts a tossed-up delivery outside off and Tom Banton defends it safely down into the off-side.
16.1: Haris Rauf delivers a full, straight 137kph ball that swings in, Root swivels his wrists, and the ball clips down to mid-on, leaving no runs.
16.2: Haris Rauf pitches up in the channel outside off, and Joe Root drives it tamely straight to the cover fielder.
16.3: Haris Rauf digs it in short, and Joe Root pulls the pace away fine past the sliding fielder for four.
16.4: Haris Rauf targets the length, angling it in to jam Joe Root who stabs it firmly toward cover.
16.5: Haris Rauf digs it in short at 141kph, and Joe Root rolls his wrists to pull it away behind square for a single.
16.6: Haris Rauf delivers from back of a length outside off, patted down wide of cover for a quick single by Tom Banton.
17.1: Saim Ayub fires it flat into the stumps, allowing Tom Banton to clip it cleanly down to long-on.
17.2: Saim Ayub tosses up an 83kph delivery on off, prodded back through mid-off by Joe Root for a single.
17.3: Saim Ayub serves one wide of the stumps, chopped sharply into the off-side by Tom Banton for a single.
17.4: Saim Ayub drops a flatter one outside off, which Joe Root hangs back to glide away past backward point for four.
17.5: Saim Ayub flights it full outside off, driven away through extra cover by Joe Root for a single.
17.6: Saim Ayub drops it short at 75kph, and Tom Banton steps back to club a drive out to deep extra cover for two runs.
29.1: Minhas bowls a flatter off‑ball that Curran punches off the back foot to long‑on, the ball floating up before dinking back down for a single.
29.2: Arafat Minhas bowls to Jordan Cox, tossing a ball up on middle that Cox punches back at the bowler, forcing a fumble and a hurried return as Cox eyes a single.
29.3: Arafat Minhas bowls to Jordan Cox, tosses one on the leg‑stump line; Cox clips wide of mid‑wicket for a single.
29.4: Arafat Minhas delivers to Sam Curran, a short fraction on off that Cox nudges back and nudges it to long‑on for a single.
29.5: Arafat Minhas bowls to Jordan Cox, tosses up just outside off; Cox drives down to long‑off for a single.
29.6: Minhas floats a ball around off that eases down to long‑on, whipping it away for a single.
30.1: Naseem Shah bowls a good‑length around off to Sam Curran, who defends it back at the bowler for no run.
30.2: Naseem Shah bowls a tad fuller and angled across Sam Curran, who sends it down to third man for a single.
30.3: Naseem Shah bowls over‑pitched just outside off to Jordan Cox, who presents a full face and drives it past extra‑cover for a four.
30.4: Naseem Shah bowls a good‑length just outside off to Jordan Cox, who taps it toward backward point for no run.
30.5: Naseem Shah bowls a good‑length with a hint of shape away to Jordan Cox, who is beaten on the outside edge for no run.
30.6: Naseem Shah bowls a back‑of‑a‑length outside off to Jordan Cox, who plays an open‑face shot for a single.
31.1: Haris Rauf delivers a 1‑run uppish ball to Jordan Cox, who drives it on the rise and wide of cover, and Faheem makes a diving stop at mid‑off to keep the boundary at bay.
31.2: Haris Rauf bowls a fuller round‑the‑wicket delivery to Sam Curran, who pushes forward and skews it off the inside half to mid‑wicket, ending with no runs.

31.3: Haris Rauf bowls a back‑of‑the‑length delivery to Sam Curran, who swivels across and swings a top‑edge to deep backward square leg where (sub)Ghazi Ghori takes a fine overhead catch for a wicket.
31.4: Will Jacks does not score off Haris Rauf.
37.3: Shaheen Afridi hits a good length outside off, and Will Jacks nudges it toward cover-point to scamper through for a quick single.
37.4: Shaheen Afridi fires it in full, and Gus Atkinson gets his bat down sharply to squeeze the yorker onto the on-side.
37.5: Shaheen Afridi serves it wide on a length, inviting Gus Atkinson to throw his hands at it for a thick outside edge that flies down to third man.
37.6: Shaheen Afridi digs it in short into the right-hander, allowing Will Jacks to ride the bounce and pull it smoothly along the ground past square leg.
38.1: Arafat Minhas drops it short and claims his fifth wicket as Will Jacks mistimes a pull straight to the Pakistani captain at mid-wicket.
38.2: Arafat Minhas slides one into Adil Rashid, trapping the batsman plumb in front to secure his sixth wicket after a successful review confirms three reds.
38.3: Arafat Minhas tosses it up on middle and leg, and Sonny Baker confidently defends the delivery straight back to the bowler.
38.4: Arafat Minhas executes a direct hit after a disastrous mix-up between the batsmen, running out Gus Atkinson to seal an 87-run victory for Pakistan.
